scope: In a common matched family basis E=Ye^T=kD+a b†+F, k>0, rank F<=1, b an identifiable pure quark column and the left neutrino-null line transported to the charged lepton basis. Freely available charged-singlet basis and unmeasured phases. All three up masses and CKM inherited; no additional rank condition on the up Yukawa. Six charged Yukawas and CKM are SM-MSbar reference data at 1e16 GeV. Neutral mixing transported to this basis within explicitly stated angle. No independent neutral masses/Yukawas predicted.
